data.body:
RESIDUAL-GAP DISPOSITION SWEEP (Phase 5, before the epic closes). Every enumerable gap this run
produced, each with exactly one disposition.

FILED (3 tickets + the 14 mirror tickets already filed):
 - 8d66-52ad daring-pancreatic-larva, discovered_from 8ce5: three untested evaluate() paths in the
   parity gate (STALE DIVERGENCE, merge_declarations carry-forward, _check_normalization).
 - c678-e73c rubellite-condensed-bettong, discovered_from 15f2: _check_home_escape may over-flag any
   argv mentioning home/mkdtemp/TemporaryDirectory (latent, 0 live sites, but false positives are
   what get a guard reverted); the UsageError contract is asserted by GREPPING conftest text rather
   than on the raised type; the file-level opt-out fallback for helper-hosted hazards is untested.
 - the 14 representation-mirror tickets under epic f79d undamaged-murderous-horse (filed earlier).

FIXED IN SCOPE (found late, fixed rather than deferred):
 - co_names parity blind spot, with FIVE unflagged real mismatches in the shipped manifest (2503).
 - _facade_function falling open and returning a harness stub (2503).
 - the guard s selection-scoping defect: pytest <file>::<one_test> failed whenever another test in
   the file owned a marked hazard (2506).
 - duplicated module-level helpers in the guard oracle (2506).
 - the O_EXCL literal count in fsutil.py (2505) and my own nested-pytest launch outside the
   sanctioned helper (2506) — both caught only by the full tier.
 - the measurement corpus 1,793 -> 1,795, from a resolution universe that inconsistently dropped
   Jira-bridged tickets (2507).

ACCEPTED, with reasons:
 - Surface-parity census, out-of-scope slots: CLI / MCP-tool / library-facade for 8ce5, 9ca8 and
   b0ac. The first two ship LINT GATES, which are not operations reachable through those surfaces
   (none of the 23 sibling check_*.py is); b0ac changes an internal ATOMICITY property, and driving
   it from a surface would not cross the faulty seam any better. Automated-callers and
   dual-direction slots were IN scope and are proven.
 - ~15 statically undecidable env= sites reported, never failed (15f2). Deliberate: failing what
   cannot be proven safe would redden dozens of files at introduction.
 - Gerrit-joined figures excluded from the offline --all-work mode (0880). They need credentials;
   excluding them keeps the shipped script portable and CI-provider-independent, and the report says
   so explicitly.
 - The adoption-half of the atomic-write oracle asserts source text (2505 advisory). Adoption IS the
   contract there (AC2/AC5), and it is the only half that fails DETERMINISTICALLY before the fix,
   because pre-fix and post-fix code publish through different seams.
 - Module sizes over the 200-500 house target: check_mcp_library_parity.py 572,
   _subprocess_isolation.py ~519, all far under the 800 cap, and scripts/ is outside the gate s
   scope. Splitting either would produce a sub-100-LOC file, which the policy explicitly forbids.
 - 9ca8 deviations from its own file_impact: tests in tests/unit/ not tests/scripts/ (the direct
   precedent test_complexity_baseline.py lives there); --lock omitted (it exists only because the
   complexity THRESHOLD is administrator-locked); a fifth helper module markers.py (the marker idiom
   is used by all three detectors and the entrypoint).
 - ci_gate count: the plan s table says 280 (29 + 251), the implementation derives 257 (31 + 226)
   live. The baseline is self-consistent with what the detector finds, which is what a ratchet needs;
   the plan s figure came from a grep and is now stale. Recorded, not reconciled.

NONE OUTSTANDING: no enumerated gap is left without a disposition.
